questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I [think] differently about the problem, we might have avoided this situation.'
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would not accept that offer.
If I was you, I would not accept that offer.
If I had been you, I would not accept that offer.
If I will be you, I would not accept that offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would not accept that offer.

questions.question: Select the option that demonstrates correct ellipsis in the following sentence: 'She can swim, but her brother cannot swim as ____.'
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to emphasize the location of the event?
options: It was in the park that the children saw the famous musician.
It was the park that the children saw the famous musician in.
In the park, the children saw the famous musician.
The famous musician was seen by the children in the park.
questions.answer: It was in the park that the children saw the famous musician.
